cheats.name: $250,000 (Unofficial)
cheats.details: Unofficial: reported by PC Gamer and Press Start from review copies, not yet confirmed by Vice Tracker. Unlocks after you finish the main story. Open the phone (D-pad Up), hold L1 + R1 (LB + RB on Xbox), then enter the D-pad sequence. Xbox buttons are the expected equivalent; no source has listed them yet. Using a cheat turns off saving until you reload.

codes.playstation: Phone open, hold L1 + R1: Up, Right, Down, Left, Up, Left, Down, Right
codes.xbox: Phone open, hold LB + RB: Up, Right, Down, Left, Up, Left, Down, Right
